text:
[LEXP.7.13.1] DS integers are 64-bit signed. Overflow wraps silently
(two's complement). The spec does not guard against it — rules
doing arithmetic on values near `INT64_MAX` are author
responsibility. Documented; no runtime overflow check.

idris.name: lexp_7_13_1__wrap
idris.note: 64-bit two's-complement wrap: overflow wraps silently. Run on INT64_MAX + 1 and on negating INT64_MIN in Main.idr, since Integer arithmetic does not reduce during elaboration.

idris.name: lexp_7_2__int_op
idris.note: Every Int operator of the fragment wraps its result; INT64_MIN // -1 wraps to INT64_MIN and INT64_MIN % -1 is 0, run in Main.idr.
